title: 第二百零一章
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“小姐……”

知道祝予的朋友来了，佣人端来了茶跟点心，刚好撞上了从房间里出来的两人。

“帮我放到房间里吧。”

看一眼她端着的东西，祝予说道。

佣人点点头，走之前忍不住又看一眼那个长相格外好看又眼熟的少年。

奇怪，怎么感觉两个人氛围怪怪的。

等人走了后，祝予清清嗓子，也没看余疏：“去我房间吗？”

“去你房间，继续刚才的事吗？”

余疏拽拽她的裙子。

祝予无言以对，对着他的小腿踢了一脚直接走人。

被踹了一脚，余疏脸上却看不出什么恼怒，反倒翘起唇角，伸手拽住了祝予裙子后面飘带，跟了过去。

上完茶点，佣人便离开了，祝予的会客厅里只剩两人。

余疏进到客厅里一眼便看到了被放置在光照充足地方的那盆绚烂的太阳花，他眼里闪过瞬间的笑意。

随即目光落到了墙壁上挂着的照片上。

“你小时候长这样。”

余疏看向最中间的相框，上面是一家人的合照，祝予约莫五六岁的模样，小小一个被周复之抱在怀里，这时候还是个妹妹头，正皱着脸，满脸不乐意的看向镜头。

“怎么这副表情。”

伸出手指点点了上面的小人，余疏偏头看向凑过来的祝予。

祝予回想了一下：“好像是刚睡醒。”

她小时候皮的很，再加上有家里人宠着，有些任性，偶尔也会发生被祝今也摁在腿上打屁股的情况。

余疏打量了她一眼：“看不出来。”

从他认识祝予的时候，她看起来就脾气很好的样子。

祝予心想以前的话那是没招了，现在是因为过得太幸福没有什么能令她发脾气的事儿。

唯一的烦恼就是……

“你跟秦表哥聊过了吗？”

祝予问的时候语气不自觉带上了些小心翼翼。

话音刚落，脸颊就被一只手捏住晃了晃。

“不许用这种语气跟我说话。”

她正疑惑是什么语气，就听他继续道：“没什么是你不能问的，不用这么小心。”

祝予挪开目光，缓缓应了声：“……哦。”

气氛一时之间凝滞起来。

Page (1/3)

"Miss..."

Knowing that Zhu Yu's friend was coming, the servant brought tea and snacks and happened to bump into the two people coming out of the room.

"Put it in the room for me."

Zhu Yu said after taking a look at what she was holding.

The servant nodded and couldn't help but take another look at the particularly good-looking and familiar young man before leaving.

It's strange, why do the two of them feel like they have a strange atmosphere.

After the others left, Zhu Yu cleared his throat without looking at Yu Shu: "Want to go to my room?"

"Go to your room and continue what you were doing?"

Yu Shu tugged on her skirt.

Zhu Yu was speechless, kicked him in the calf and left.

After being kicked, there was no trace of anger on Yu Shu's face. Instead, he raised the corners of his lips, reached out and grabbed the ribbon at the back of Zhu Yu's skirt, and followed him.

After serving tea, the servant left, leaving only two people in Zhu Yu's living room.

When Yu Shu entered the living room, he immediately saw the gorgeous pot of sunflowers placed in a well-lit place, and a momentary smile flashed in his eyes.

Then his eyes fell on the photos hanging on the wall.

"You looked like this when you were a kid."

Yu Shu looked at the photo frame in the middle. It was a photo of the family. Zhu Yu looked about five or six years old. The little one was held in Zhou Fuzhi's arms. At this time, she was still a little girl. She was frowning and looking at the camera with an unhappy face.

"Why this expression?"

Pointing his finger at the little man above, Yu Shu turned his head and looked at Zhu Yu, who was approaching.

Zhu Yu thought about it for a moment: "It seems that I just woke up."

She was very naughty when she was a child, and because she was pampered by her family, she was a little willful. Occasionally, she would be pressed on her lap by Zhu Jinye and spanked.

Yu Shu looked her over and said, "I can't tell."

From the time he met Zhu Yu, she seemed to have a good temper.

Zhu Yu thought to herself that there was nothing she could do in the past, but now she was living too happily and there was nothing that could make her lose her temper.

The only trouble is...

"Have you talked to Cousin Qin?"

Zhu Yu's tone was unconsciously cautious when he asked.

As soon as he finished speaking, his cheek was pinched by a hand and shook.

"Don't talk to me in that tone."

Just as she was wondering about his tone, she heard him continue: "There's nothing you can't ask, so you don't have to be so careful."

Zhu Yu looked away and responded slowly: "...Oh."

The atmosphere suddenly became stagnant.
